name: PM-KISAN
description: Direct income support for eligible farmer families across India.
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year transferred in three installments.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families meeting PM-KISAN rules.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance support against natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
benefits: Low premium insurance cover with claim support during crop loss.
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.

name: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop
description: Support for micro-irrigation, water conservation, and efficient farm irrigation systems.
benefits: Subsidy support for drip and sprinkler irrigation systems.
eligibility: Farmers applying for approved irrigation improvements.

name: Kisan Credit Card
description: Short-term affordable institutional credit for crop production and allied activities.
benefits: Working capital access with concessional interest support.
eligibility: Farmers, dairy farmers, and fishers as per KCC guidelines.

name: Soil Health Card
description: Scientific soil testing and nutrient recommendations for balanced fertilizer use.
benefits: Actionable soil nutrient guidance to improve yield and reduce input waste.
eligibility: Available to farmers through local agriculture departments and labs.
